title: Multi-User Large Language Model Agents
abstract: arXiv:2604.08567v3 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) and LLM-based agents are increasingly deployed as assistants in planning and decision making, yet most existing systems are implicitly optimized for a single-principal interaction paradigm, in which the model is designed to satisfy the objectives of one dominant user whose instructions are treated as the sole source of authority and utility. However, as they are integrated into team workflows and organizational tools, they are increasingly required to serve multiple users simultaneously, each with distinct roles, preferences, and authority levels, leading to multi-user, multi-principal settings with unavoidable conflicts, information asymmetry, and privacy constraints. In this work, we present the first systematic study of multi-user LLM agents. translated_title: 多用户大语言模型智能体
translated_abstract: 大语言模型（LLM）及基于LLM的智能体正越来越多地被部署为规划和决策中的助手，然而现有的大多数系统都隐含地针对单主体交互范式进行了优化，即模型被设计为满足单一主导用户的目标，该用户的指令被视为唯一的权威与效用来源。然而，随着这些模型被集成到团队工作流和组织工具中，它们日益需要同时服务于多个用户，而每个用户拥有不同的角色、偏好和权限级别，从而形成了多用户、多主体的环境，其中不可避免地存在冲突、信息不对称和隐私约束。在本工作中，我们对多用户LLM智能体进行了首次系统性研究。我们首先将LLM智能体的多用户交互形式化为一个多主体决策问题，其中一个智能体必须同时考虑多个具有潜在……（原文摘要此处截断）
tldr: 该论文首次系统性地研究了多用户大语言模型智能体，将LLM智能体的多用户交互形式化为多主体决策问题，以应对多用户场景下不可避免的冲突、信息不对称和隐私约束。
en_tdlr: This paper presents the first systematic study of multi-user LLM agents, formalizing multi-user interaction with LLM agents as a multi-principal decision problem to handle unavoidable conflicts, information asymmetry, and privacy constraints when serving multiple users simultaneously.
